"Brave" is an outside trait.
Inside traits tell us what a person is like.
"Curly hair" is an inside trait.

title: Lunch Break
intro: It is lunch break at Sunrise School. Watch what each child does. Actions show us inside traits.

title: The Lost Kitten

Circle True or False.

items.q: Imran is responsible because
items.a: e.g. Imran is responsible because he puts up posters to find the owner.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: A smart suit tells us that a person is polite.

sections.title: Finish each sentence with a clue from the story.

items.q: The man is impatient because
items.a: e.g. The man is impatient because he shouts at the staff when the queue is slow.
